highlights.title: CPR and CVR
highlights.text: Local identifier workbenches split body, prefixes, control evidence, and official lookup boundaries.

highlights.title: Moms / VAT and payments
highlights.text: Tax, VAT, IBAN, payment reference, and reconciliation tools keep browser-only checks separate from regulated status.

highlights.title: Developer debugging
highlights.text: CSV, JSON, API, form, privacy, fixture, and locale tools expose field breakdown and developer payloads.

developerNotes.title: No official claims
developerNotes.text: Offline checks never prove official Denmark registry, tax, bank, vehicle, postal, or identity status.

developerNotes.title: Field breakdown required
developerNotes.text: Every tool must keep named slices visible because they are the primary debugging surface.

developerNotes.title: Same-country links
developerNotes.text: Related workbenches stay inside /denmark/ unless a comparison route is explicitly designed.

commonMistakes.title: Treating syntax as status
commonMistakes.text: A passing checksum or shape check is not an official lookup result.

commonMistakes.title: Logging raw personal data
commonMistakes.text: Use masked previews for tickets, logs, analytics, and screenshots.

commonMistakes.title: Ignoring locale separators
commonMistakes.text: Use Comma (,) and Dot (.) rules before API normalization.

commonMistakes.title: Mixing countries
commonMistakes.text: Do not reuse non-Danish examples, fallback copy, or related links in this suite.

officialSources.title: CVR register
officialSources.text: Official business registry or company lookup remains the source of truth for Denmark.

officialSources.title: Moms / VAT
officialSources.text: Tax/VAT validity and filing acceptance require the responsible tax authority or VIES where applicable.

officialSources.title: GDPR / Datatilsynet
officialSources.text: Privacy obligations require legal/process review outside browser-only diagnostics.
